plugins.name: jira-issue-triage
plugins.description: End-to-end Jira issue triage subagent across all archetypes (Bug, Incident, Feature, Task, Spike). Ships /jira-issue-triage:setup and /jira-issue-triage:investigate-and-refine.

plugins.name: azure-issue-triage
plugins.description: End-to-end Azure DevOps work-item triage subagent across all archetypes (Bug, Incident, User Story, Feature, Task, Spike). Sibling of jira-issue-triage. Ships /azure-issue-triage:setup and /azure-issue-triage:investigate-and-refine. Bundles a Rolai-shaped Azure DevOps MCP config (override the .mcp.json locally if your org differs).

plugins.name: azure-incident-postmortem
plugins.description: Generates a Google-SRE-style blameless postmortem for an Azure DevOps incident work item. Gathers evidence from Microsoft Teams, related work items, Datadog logs, and Azure Repos merges; pauses for review; produces the document. Ships /azure-incident-postmortem:setup.
